question_de: Wie viele gehaltene, neu aktive und nicht mehr aktive Kunden gab es je Land zwischen dem 31.03.2026 und dem 30.06.2026, gemessen an unserer Aktiv-Definition (90-Tage-Fenster bis zum jeweiligen Stichtag, ohne Stornos, ohne gelöschte Konten)?
gold_sql:
WITH active_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.country_code
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
active_start AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.country_code
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
retained AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
),
newly_active AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
),
churned AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
),
countries AS (
  SELECT country_code FROM active_end
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT country_code FROM active_start
)
SELECT
  co.country_code,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retained r WHERE r.country_code = co.country_code) AS gehaltene_kunden,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM newly_active n WHERE n.country_code = co.country_code) AS neu_aktive_kunden,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned ch WHERE ch.country_code = co.country_code) AS nicht_mehr_aktive_kunden
FROM countries co
ORDER BY co.country_code
rationale_de: Zwei relative 90-Tage-Aktivfenster gegen die Stichtage 2026-03-31 und 2026-06-30 gemäß Hausdefinition Aktiver Kunde; Mengenoperationen (INTERSECT/EXCEPT) in CTEs liefern gehaltene, neu aktive und nicht mehr aktive Kunden je country_code.

question_de: Welche aktiven Kunden hatten ihre erste qualifizierende Bestellung im aktuellen 90-Tage-Fenster erst im Juni 2026? Gib customer_id, customer_number und das Datum dieser ersten Bestellung zurück.
gold_sql:
WITH window_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    o.order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS rn
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_number,
  order_date AS first_qualifying_order_date
FROM window_orders
WHERE rn = 1
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY customer_id
rationale_de: Aktiver Kunde laut Glossar: nicht gelöscht und mindestens eine nicht stornierte Bestellung im 90-Tage-Fenster bis SNAPSHOT_DATE. Qualifizierende Bestellungen sind dieselben nicht stornierten Orders. Per CTE und ROW_NUMBER wird die erste Order im Fenster bestimmt; nur Kunden, deren erste Fenster-Order in den Juni 2026 fällt, werden ausgegeben.

question_de: Wie hoch ist die Bindungsquote der Aktiven Kunden vom Stichtag 2025-12-31 zu denen, die am 2026-03-31 weiterhin Aktive Kunden sind? Ein Aktiver Kunde hat mindestens eine nicht stornierte Bestellung in den 90 Tagen bis einschließlich des jeweiligen Stichtags und gelöschte Konten sind an jedem Stichtag auszuschließen. Gib die Quote als Anteil der zum ersten Stichtag Aktiven Kunden aus, die auch zum zweiten Stichtag aktiv sind.
gold_sql:
WITH active_2025_12_31 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
active_2026_03_31 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id,
         CASE WHEN b.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_flag
  FROM active_2025_12_31 a
  LEFT JOIN active_2026_03_31 b
    ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_flag), COUNT(*)) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort
rationale_de: Zwei CTEs bilden die Hausdefinition Aktiver Kunde jeweils über ein relatives 90-Tage-Fenster bis 2025-12-31 bzw. 2026-03-31; gelöschte Konten werden nur über c.deleted_at IS NULL ausgeschlossen. Die Bindungsquote ist der Mengenanteil der ersten Kohorte, der in der zweiten Menge liegt (LEFT JOIN / Set-Logik).

question_de: Wie unterscheidet sich der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren je Hauptkategorie zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026? Bitte die Kategoriehierarchie auflösen, Retourenerstattungen je Bestellposition voraggregieren und für jede Hauptkategorie den Deckungsbeitrag beider Halbjahre sowie die absolute Veränderung ausweisen, sortiert nach Hauptkategorie.
gold_sql:
WITH refunds_per_item AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN c.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN c.category_id
      ELSE c.parent_category_id
    END AS main_category_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds_per_item rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
),
period_agg AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    CASE
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      ELSE 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS cm_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS cm_h1_2026
  FROM period_agg
  GROUP BY main_category_id
)
SELECT
  mc.category_name AS hauptkategorie,
  p.cm_h1_2025,
  p.cm_h1_2026,
  p.cm_h1_2026 - p.cm_h1_2025 AS delta_cm
FROM pivoted p
JOIN ecom_v1.categories mc ON mc.category_id = p.main_category_id
ORDER BY mc.category_name;
rationale_de: Harte Hausdefinition Deckungsbeitrag inkl. explizitem Retourenabzug, Self-Join-Logik der Hauptkategorie, Voraggregation der refund_amount je order_item und Periodenvergleich H1 2025 vs. H1 2026 über mehrere CTEs.

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorien hatten 2025 einen niedrigeren Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren als 2024? Gib je Hauptkategorie den Namen sowie den Deckungsbeitrag 2024 und 2025 aus.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_date,
    COALESCE(parent.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS cm
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, yr
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    cm,
    LAG(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS cm_prev
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  cm_prev AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  cm AS deckungsbeitrag_2025
FROM compared
WHERE yr = 2025
  AND cm_prev IS NOT NULL
  AND cm < cm_prev
ORDER BY main_category_name;
rationale_de: Deckungsbeitrag nach Hausdefinition auf Netto-Umsatz inkl. explizitem Retourenabzug, minus EK und Partnerprovision; Hauptkategorie per Self-Join; YoY 2024 vs. 2025 über CTE und LAG, nur rückläufige Kategorien.

question_de: Wie hoch ist der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren je Hauptkategorie im ersten und zweiten Quartal 2026, und wie groß ist die absolute Veränderung von Q1 auf Q2?
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS hauptkategorie,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' THEN 'Q1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'Q2'
    END AS quartal,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    quartal,
    SUM(deckungsbeitrag) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie, quartal
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quartal = 'Q1' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_q1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quartal = 'Q2' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_q2
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_q1,
  db_q2,
  db_q2 - db_q1 AS absolute_veraenderung
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY hauptkategorie;
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag inklusive explizitem Retourenabzug (Netto-Umsatz nach MwSt/Rabatt/Storno minus refund_amount, minus EK, minus Partnerprovision), Roll-up auf Hauptkategorien per Self-Join sowie den Periodenvergleich Q1 vs. Q2 2026 mit absoluter Differenz über mehrere CTEs.

question_de: Welche drei Hauptkategorien verzeichneten den größten Anstieg des Deckungsbeitrags nach Abzug von Retouren vom zweiten Halbjahr 2024 zum zweiten Halbjahr 2025? Bitte Hauptkategoriename, Deckungsbeitrag H2 2024, Deckungsbeitrag H2 2025 und die absolute Veränderung ausgeben.
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pc.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(pc.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 'h2_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'h2_2025'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories pc ON pc.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE (o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    ))
),
period_cm AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    period,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, period
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(a.main_category_id, b.main_category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(a.main_category_name, b.main_category_name) AS main_category_name,
    COALESCE(a.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_h2_2024,
    COALESCE(b.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_h2_2025,
    COALESCE(b.contribution_margin, 0) - COALESCE(a.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_increase
  FROM period_cm a
  FULL OUTER JOIN period_cm b
    ON a.main_category_id = b.main_category_id
   AND a.period = 'h2_2024'
   AND b.period = 'h2_2025'
  WHERE COALESCE(a.period, 'h2_2024') = 'h2_2024'
    AND COALESCE(b.period, 'h2_2025') = 'h2_2025'
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  cm_h2_2024,
  cm_h2_2025,
  cm_increase
FROM compared
ORDER BY cm_increase DESC, main_category_name ASC
LIMIT 3
rationale_de: H2-Perioden 2024 vs. 2025, Hauptkategorie per Self-Join, Deckungsbeitrag nach Retouren mit voraggregierten refund_amount je order_item_id; Wareneinsatz bleibt quantity*purchase_price; Datumsfilter und Nicht-Storno stehen gemeinsam in einer Klammer.

question_de: Wie hat sich der prozentuale Anteil jeder Hauptkategorie am gesamten Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren zwischen den Kalenderjahren 2024 und 2025 verändert? Gib je Hauptkategorie den Anteil 2024, den Anteil 2025 und die Differenz in Prozentpunkten aus, sortiert nach Hauptkategoriename.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    CASE
      WHEN c.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN c.category_id
      ELSE c.parent_category_id
    END AS main_category_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
cat_year AS (
  SELECT
    mc.category_name AS hauptkategorie,
    lc.yr,
    SUM(lc.contribution_margin) AS cm
  FROM line_cm lc
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories mc ON mc.category_id = lc.main_category_id
  GROUP BY mc.category_name, lc.yr
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    yr,
    cm,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cm, SUM(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY yr)) * 100 AS share_pct
  FROM cat_year
)
SELECT
  y24.hauptkategorie,
  y24.share_pct AS anteil_2024_pct,
  y25.share_pct AS anteil_2025_pct,
  y25.share_pct - y24.share_pct AS differenz_pp
FROM with_share y24
JOIN with_share y25
  ON y24.hauptkategorie = y25.hauptkategorie
 AND y24.yr = 2024
 AND y25.yr = 2025
ORDER BY y24.hauptkategorie
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag inklusive Netto-Umsatz nach Retouren (MwSt, Rabatt, Stornos, refund_amount), COGS und Partnerprovision, die Zuordnung zur Hauptkategorie über parent_category_id, Jahresvergleich 2024 vs. 2025 sowie den Anteil am jeweiligen Jahres-Gesamt-DB per Window-Funktion in CTEs.

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorien hatten im Kalenderjahr 2025 einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag vor Retouren, aber einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug der Retouren? Gib Hauptkategorie-ID, Name sowie beide Deckungsbeiträge aus, sortiert nach Name.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pc.category_id, c.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(pc.category_name, c.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_before_returns,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_after_returns
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories pc ON pc.category_id = c.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    SUM(cm_before_returns) AS cm_before_returns,
    SUM(cm_after_returns) AS cm_after_returns,
    SUM(SUM(cm_before_returns)) OVER () AS total_cm_before_2025,
    SUM(SUM(cm_after_returns)) OVER () AS total_cm_after_2025
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name
),
pos_before AS (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM agg WHERE cm_before_returns > 0
),
neg_after AS (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM agg WHERE cm_after_returns < 0
)
SELECT
  a.main_category_id,
  a.main_category_name,
  a.cm_before_returns,
  a.cm_after_returns
FROM agg a
WHERE a.main_category_id IN (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM pos_before
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT main_category_id FROM neg_after
)
ORDER BY a.main_category_name, a.main_category_id
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz ohne Stornos, minus EK, minus Partnerprovision) einmal vor und einmal nach Abzug der refund_amount, für das Kalenderjahr 2025 (order_date). Hauptkategorien entstehen per Self-Join auf categories. Struktur: mehrere CTEs, Window-Summen über alle Hauptkategorien als Periodenvergleich vor/nach Retouren im selben Jahr, und INTERSECT der Mengen mit positivem Vor- bzw. negativem Nach-Retouren-DB.

question_de: Wie hoch war 2025 je Hauptkategorie der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren bei Partnerkanälen im Vergleich zu Nicht-Partner-Kanälen?
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS hauptkategorie,
    ch.channel_type,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel_type = 'partner' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_partner,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel_type != 'partner' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_nicht_partner
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_partner,
  db_nicht_partner,
  db_partner - db_nicht_partner AS db_differenz_partner_minus_nicht_partner,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY db_partner - db_nicht_partner DESC, hauptkategorie) AS rang_differenz
FROM agg
ORDER BY hauptkategorie;
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag inklusive explizitem Retourenabzug (Netto-Umsatz nach MwSt/Rabatt/Storno minus refund_amount, minus EK, minus Partnerprovision auf den Bruttowert), den Self-Join auf Hauptkategorien und den Vergleich Partner- versus Nicht-Partner-Kanäle für das Kalenderjahr 2025; CTEs plus RANK-Window liefern die geforderte Struktur.

question_de: Wie unterscheidet sich der durchschnittliche Deckungsbeitrag je Bestellung nach Retouren je Hauptkategorie zwischen den Kalenderjahren 2024 und 2025? Gib je Hauptkategorie den Wert 2024, den Wert 2025 und die Differenz 2025 minus 2024 aus.
gold_sql:
WITH ret AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    COALESCE(parent.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(ret.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
year_cat AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    order_year,
    SUM(contribution_margin) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_cm_per_order
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, order_year
),
cmp AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    order_year,
    avg_cm_per_order,
    LAG(avg_cm_per_order) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY order_year) AS avg_cm_per_order_prev
  FROM year_cat
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  avg_cm_per_order_prev AS avg_cm_per_order_2024,
  avg_cm_per_order AS avg_cm_per_order_2025,
  avg_cm_per_order - avg_cm_per_order_prev AS delta_2025_minus_2024
FROM cmp
WHERE order_year = 2025
ORDER BY main_category_name;
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag inklusive Netto-Umsatz nach Retouren, Stornoausschluss, COGS und Partnerprovision. Retouren werden je order_item_id voraggregiert, Hauptkategorien über den Kategorien-Self-Join ermittelt, Jahre 2024/2025 verglichen und der Durchschnitt je Bestellung per CTE plus LAG-Window berechnet.

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorien hatten von 2024 auf 2025 einen gestiegenen retourenbereinigten Deckungsbeitrag, obwohl der retourenbereinigte Netto-Umsatz zurückging? Gib die Hauptkategorienamen aus.
gold_sql:
WITH line_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_rev_adj,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_adj
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    SUM(net_rev_adj) AS net_rev,
    SUM(cm_adj) AS cm
  FROM line_metrics
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, yr
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    net_rev,
    cm,
    LAG(net_rev) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_net_rev,
    LAG(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_cm
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT main_category_name
FROM compared
WHERE yr = 2025
  AND prev_net_rev IS NOT NULL
  AND net_rev < prev_net_rev
  AND cm > prev_cm
ORDER BY main_category_name;
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag auf Basis des retourenbereinigten Netto-Umsatzes (MwSt, Rabatt, Stornos, Refunds, EK, Partnerprovision) sowie Hauptkategorien per Self-Join. Der Periodenvergleich 2024 vs. 2025 erfolgt über CTEs und LAG; gefiltert werden Kategorien mit fallendem Netto-Umsatz und steigendem Deckungsbeitrag.

question_de: Vergleiche den retourenbereinigten Deckungsbeitrag je Hauptkategorie zwischen den letzten 90 Tagen bis einschließlich 2025-12-31 und dem unmittelbar davor liegenden 90-Tage-Fenster. Gib je Hauptkategorie den Deckungsbeitrag der aktuellen Periode, den der Vorperiode sowie die absolute Differenz (aktuell minus Vorperiode) aus, sortiert nach Hauptkategoriename.
gold_sql:
WITH windows AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AS curr_start,
    DATE '2025-12-31' AS curr_end,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY), INTERVAL 91 DAY) AS prev_start,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS prev_end
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN cat.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN cat.category_name
      ELSE parent.category_name
    END AS hauptkategorie,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN w.curr_start AND w.curr_end THEN 'aktuell'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN w.prev_start AND w.prev_end THEN 'vorperiode'
    END AS periode,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS db
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  CROSS JOIN windows w
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN w.curr_start AND w.curr_end
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN w.prev_start AND w.prev_end
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    periode,
    SUM(db) AS db
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie, periode
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN periode = 'aktuell' THEN db ELSE 0 END) AS db_aktuell,
    SUM(CASE WHEN periode = 'vorperiode' THEN db ELSE 0 END) AS db_vorperiode
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_aktuell,
  db_vorperiode,
  db_aktuell - db_vorperiode AS db_differenz
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY hauptkategorie
rationale_de: Retourenbereinigter Deckungsbeitrag verlangt Netto-Umsatz inkl. Abzug der refund_amount, minus Wareneinsatz und Partnerprovision; Hauptkategorie über Self-Join auf categories; zwei angrenzende 90-Tage-Fenster relativ zu 2025-12-31, Aggregation per CTE und Periodenvergleich.

question_de: Welche Kundensegmente haben über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen hinweg einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag? Bitte zuerst den vorzeichenbehafteten Deckungsbeitrag je Segment aggregieren und anschließend nur Segmente mit einem Gesamtwert unter null ausgeben.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
seg AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    SUM(contribution_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM line_cm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  segment,
  deckungsbeitrag
FROM seg
WHERE deckungsbeitrag < 0
ORDER BY segment
rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz minus EK minus Partnerprovision) auf Positionszeilen, Aggregation per Window SUM über Kundensegment, Filter der Gruppen mit negativem Vorzeichen; Stornos ausgeschlossen, keine Zeitfilter.

semantic_review.notes: Signed line contribution margins are aggregated per segment before filtering; glossary formula and cancellation filter are correct. Empty result is valid for the current data.

question_de: Welche Vertriebskanäle hatten im Kalenderjahr 2025 einen negativen gesamten Deckungsbeitrag? Bitte den Deckungsbeitrag erst je Kanal aggregieren und erst danach filtern; einzelne Positionen dürfen nicht vor der Aggregation als Verlust klassifiziert werden. Gib Kanalname und den aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag aus, aufsteigend nach Deckungsbeitrag und Kanalname.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.channel_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
channel_cm AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS deckungsbeitrag,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(contribution_margin) ASC, channel_id) AS rk
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY channel_id
),
negative_ids AS (
  SELECT channel_id FROM channel_cm
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT channel_id FROM channel_cm WHERE deckungsbeitrag >= 0
)
SELECT ch.channel_name, cc.deckungsbeitrag
FROM channel_cm cc
JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = cc.channel_id
JOIN negative_ids n ON n.channel_id = cc.channel_id
ORDER BY cc.deckungsbeitrag ASC, ch.channel_name ASC
rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz ohne Retourenabzug, minus EK, minus Partnerprovision auf Bruttowert) wird positionsweise berechnet, erst je Kanal summiert und danach über EXCEPT auf negative Totale gefiltert; RANK-Window und CTEs erfüllen die Strukturachse, Kalenderjahr 2025 ist absolut.

semantic_review.notes: Signed line contribution margins are aggregated per channel before the negative-total filter. The unused rank and EXCEPT CTE are redundant but do not change the correct result; empty output is valid for the current data.

question_de: Welche Produktkategorien hatten im ersten Quartal 2026 einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag insgesamt? Gib Kategorie, den vorzeichenbehafteten Deckungsbeitrag und den Rang nach aufsteigendem Deckungsbeitrag aus (bei Gleichstand nach Kategoriename).
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
),
cat_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(l.contribution_margin) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM line_cm l
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = l.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
),
neg_ids AS (
  SELECT category_id FROM cat_cm
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT category_id FROM cat_cm WHERE deckungsbeitrag >= 0
)
SELECT
  cc.category_name,
  cc.deckungsbeitrag,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cc.deckungsbeitrag ASC, cc.category_name ASC) AS rang
FROM cat_cm cc
JOIN neg_ids n ON n.category_id = cc.category_id
ORDER BY cc.deckungsbeitrag ASC, cc.category_name ASC
rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag verlangt Netto-Umsatz ohne Stornos, minus EK und Partnerprovision; Q1 2026 ist kalendarisch fest. CTEs, EXCEPT zur Menge negativer Kategorien und RANK für deterministische Sortierung.

question_de: Welche Kunden haben im zweiten Halbjahr 2025 insgesamt einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag, obwohl mindestens eine ihrer Bestellpositionen in diesem Zeitraum einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag aufweist? Gib customer_id und Kundennummer aus.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'

  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),

Der Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag verlangt Netto-Umsatz (ohne Stornos, MwSt und Rabatt, ohne Retourenabzug, da nicht signalisiert), Wareneinsatz und Partnerprovision. question_de: Welche Produkte haben über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen hinweg einen negativen aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag und kamen in mindestens fünf verschiedenen Bestellungen vor? Gib product_id, sku, product_name, den aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag und die Anzahl distinkter Bestellungen aus, sortiert nach Deckungsbeitrag aufsteigend und product_id.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    o.order_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS total_cm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY product_id
),
neg_cm AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM agg WHERE total_cm < 0
),
enough_orders AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM agg WHERE n_orders >= 5
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM neg_cm
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT product_id FROM enough_orders
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  a.total_cm AS deckungsbeitrag,
  a.n_orders,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_cm ASC, p.product_id) AS rang
FROM qualified q
JOIN agg a ON a.product_id = q.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = q.product_id
ORDER BY a.total_cm ASC, p.product_id
rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag verlangt Netto-Umsatz (Rabatt, MwSt, ohne Stornos, ohne Versand, ohne Retourenabzug) minus EK und Partnerprovision. CTEs trennen Positions-CM, Aggregation und die beiden Filter; INTERSECT bildet die Schnittmenge negativer CM und mindestens fünf distinkter Bestellungen; ROW_NUMBER erzwingt deterministische Rangfolge.

question_de: Welche Länder hatten 2024 einen negativen Gesamtdeckungsbeitrag, wenn der Deckungsbeitrag zuerst zeilenweise mit Vorzeichen berechnet und erst danach je Kundenland aggregiert wird? Gib Ländercode und Gesamtdeckungsbeitrag aus.

      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'

rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag verlangt Netto-Umsatz (ohne Stornos, MwSt und Rabatt), Wareneinsatz und Partnerprovision auf den Bruttowert. Die Aggregation erfolgt erst nach zeilenweisem Vorzeichen-CM; Window-SUM je Land plus DISTINCT filtert negative Länder ohne GROUP BY.

question_de: Welche Partnerkanäle hatten 2025 einen negativen gesamten Deckungsbeitrag nach Provision? Gib Kanal-ID, Kanalname und den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag aus.
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'

    AND ch.channel_type = 'partner'
),
channel_cm AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS total_cm,
    SUM(SUM(contribution_margin)) OVER () AS partner_cm_sum
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
)
SELECT channel_id, channel_name, total_cm
FROM channel_cm
WHERE total_cm < 0
ORDER BY channel_name, channel_id
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz ohne Retourenabzug, minus Wareneinsatz, minus Provision auf den Bruttowert) nur für Partnerkanäle im Kalenderjahr 2025. Stornos sind ausgeschlossen, order_date steuert die Periode. Zwei CTEs plus Window-Aggregation über die Kanäle erfüllen die Strukturachse; gefiltert werden nur negative Summen, sortiert deterministisch nach Name und ID.

question_de: Welche fünf Kunden haben den niedrigsten aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen, inklusive negativer und positiver Summen? Nutze einen deterministischen Top-5-Cutoff bei Gleichstand.

WITH line_cm AS (

question_de: Wie viele Kunden je Segment haben einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag, wenn man den Deckungsbeitrag zuerst je Kunde aggregiert und erst danach nach Segment zählt?
gold_sql:
WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT

      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels AS ch
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
cust_cm AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,

)

GROUP BY c.segment

rationale_de: Hausbegriff Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz ohne Retourenabzug, minus EK, minus Partnerprovision, ohne Stornos). Zuerst Positions-CTE, dann Window-Summe je Kunde mit QUALIFY zur Kundenqualifikation, erst danach Zählung je Segment.

question_de: Wie hoch ist der gesamte Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren in den 30 Tagen bis einschließlich 2026-05-31?
gold_sql:
SELECT SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) - COALESCE(rf.refund_sum, 0)) AS netto_umsatz_nach_retouren
FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_sum
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
) rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-05-31', INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND DATE '2026-05-31'
rationale_de: Hausbegriff Netto-Umsatz nach Retouren: Bruttozeile minus Rabatt, geteilt durch (1+Steuersatz), Stornos ausgeschlossen, refund_amount abgezogen. Relatives 30-Tage-Fenster endet am 2026-05-31 (order_date). Retouren voraggregiert per JOIN, damit keine verschachtelten Aggregate entstehen.

question_de: Wie hoch ist der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Vertriebskanal in den 60 Tagen bis einschließlich 2026-06-30?

question_de: Wie hoch ist der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Kundensegment in den 90 Tagen bis einschließlich 2025-12-31?

FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (

Das relative 90-Tage-Fenster endet am 2025-12-31 und wird analog zur Glossar-Konvention mit DATE_SUB(..., INTERVAL 90 DAY) aufgelöst. Stornos sind ausgeschlossen, Versandkosten nicht enthalten. Retouren werden vor dem Join nach order_item_id aggregiert, damit Teilretouren die Positionszeilen nicht multiplizieren.

question_de: Wie hoch ist der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Produktkategorie für die 45 Kalendertage bis einschließlich 2026-03-31 (Bestelldatum 2026-02-15 bis 2026-03-31)?
gold_sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  c.category_id,
  c.category_name,
  SUM(
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
    - COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0)
  ) AS netto_umsatz_nach_retouren
FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories c
  ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN refunds rf
  ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-15' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY c.category_id;
rationale_de: Die Frage verlangt den Hausbegriff Netto-Umsatz inklusive explizitem Retourenabzug, gruppiert nach Kategorie. Stornos werden ausgeschlossen, MwSt und Rabatt gemäß Glossar verrechnet. Retouren werden zuerst je order_item_id aggregiert und erst dann an die Positionen gejoined, damit Teilretouren den Umsatz nicht vervielfachen. Das Zeitfenster ist das 45-Tage-Intervall 2026-02-15 bis 2026-03-31 auf order_date.

question_de: Welche drei Zahlungsarten hatten in den 90 Tagen bis einschließlich 2026-06-30 den höchsten Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren?
